judged.rule: Shorts and Reels run 35–45 s. TikTok runs 61–75 s and includes a sourced recovery beat after the tell.
Name one current scam and document evidence that it is circulating in the stated market.
Show the bait, hook moment, point of loss and one observable tell in that order.
A legible on-screen credit gives the FTC, Action Fraud, bank or carrier and the advisory publication date with the supported claim.
Use recipient-side recognition cues, fictional brands and numbers and visibly reconstructed, inert artifacts. No reusable scam scripts or operational steps.
The episode uses original case-specific mockups and a labelled loss diagram. The tell is circled at its reveal and stock footage is absent.
Narration and burned-in captions are English. Each caption matches the spoken clause.
Use a clear ElevenLabs narrator, with AI disclosure wherever required.
